decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be removed and the site restored to its former condition on or before 30 September 2012.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (P00, Unnumbered 'Laser Box' drawing, Planning Statement, and 'Projet de Sculpture/Watermans' (F. D'Estienne D'Orves) 25/1/2011;  received 16 September 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - The display shall not be sited or operated so as to:

(a) endanger persons using any public highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);
(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway signal or aid to navigation by water or air; or
(c) hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.

Condition : 4 - The laser beams used to generate the display shall be of a power so that the laser shall not exceed a Nominal Ocular Hazard Distance (NOHD) of 600 feet (183m) above ground level at the site.

Condition : 5 - The development hereby approved shall include a system that enables to the laser(s) to be automatically switched off by phone should there be a need to do so on the grounds of flight safety, with a telephone contact number for the automated system to be submitted to the Civil Aviation Authority and to NATS London Terminal Control Centre (Swanwick) prior to the development commencing.

Condition : 6 - The lighting display hereby approved shall:

(i) Only be operated between the hours of 3pm and midnight daily
(ii) Be turned on a minimum of 30 minutes before dusk on the days it is operated.
(iii) Change images no faster than every 15 minutes.
description: Installation of a temporary public art installation (from January to September 2012 in conjunction with London Olympic 2012), comprised of laser light display, laser system and two display poles to the Watermans Centre
